The '''Andoan Free Colonies''' were a collection of fifteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]] established circa [[102 BBY/Legends|102 BBY]] in the [[Lambda sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], which were colonized by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] of the planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. In [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], the colonies declared independence from the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]] government of Ando, beginning the long and bloody [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]]. The Free Colonies suffered a serious defeat at the [[Battle of Raquish]] in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], but were saved by the intervention of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force, which separated the two sides and enforced demilitarization in the sector.

Smarting at their defeat, Ando was one of the first planets to [[Ando separation|secede]] from the Republic and join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], but most of the Free Colonies remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gorothin Vagger]] represented the Free Colonies in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
